title: The Deco BE65 v3 firmware contains a shared hard-coded password hash for the root account in… (CVE-2026-91138)
description: The Deco BE65 v3 firmware contains a shared hard-coded password hash for the root account stored in /etc/shadow. This password hash is accepted by a production authentication path. An attacker with existing unprivileged shell access may recover or obtain the plaintext password, enabling privilege escalation to root. Successful exploitation grants root-level access to the device.
